scientific_integrity: The finite checks validate only the support-transition graph, not the homotopy argument; the group calculation follows analytically from a principal torus bundle, Hopf connecting maps and van Kampen. No independent verification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The fundamental group and H_1 are computed only for finite-dimensional complex codimension-one linear isometric embeddings with 1 <= p < infinity and p != 2. Higher homotopy, other dimension gaps, real scalars and definitive priority are not claimed.
title: Free fundamental groups of complex codimension-one \(\ell^p\) isometric-embedding spaces
